destruction ray can also attack S-size units, making it a tough foe.
Sharivan's combat machine. Armed with the Moto-Sharian Laser, it can break into the Genmu World and races at 700 km/h. It launches from the Grand Birth.

One of the five warriors of the International Secret Defense Organization EAGLE's Japan branch. Peggy Matsuyama transforms into her. She reads opponents' hearts with the Heart Mirror and throws the Momo Card like a shuriken.

The temporary earthly form of Fixed-star Observer No. 340, Ultraseven. It is modeled on Jiro Satsuma, a brave young man who tried to save a friend in a climbing accident without regard for his own life. He posed as a drifter, but his achievements were recognized and he became an Ultra Garrison member. In the game he can transform at Morale 105 or higher.

A lonely boy who was a little bad at making friends, until he happened to meet Brain's robot One-Eight and shared his heart with it. One-Eight's actions were normally controlled by its Satan Circuit, but it opened its heart to him alone.
Staff officer at the TDF Far East Base. One of the five top leaders.
A UCMA unit member. Only recently assigned. Has lots of room to grow.

boasts fearsome performance as a weapon. However, information transfer after fusion is said to have limits, and to make this fusion complete, mediation by the Vol, which are archaebacterial cells, is said to be necessary.

The only woman in the Ultra Garrison, she also serves on the staff of the Defense Force's Medical Center. Granddaughter of Dr. Genzaburo Yuri, an authority on space navigation. She has faint feelings of love for Dan. In the game she has repair skills.

Grandfather of Ultra Garrison member Anne. An authority on space navigation, he later joins the TDF science group and is active as a scientist. His joining makes the "Reload Magazine S" and "EN Repair Kit S" available for development.

Inazuman's dedicated vehicle, with a dog's brain built in. It flies at Mach 3 and fights enemy fighters with rockets and its bite. It is also an all-purpose combat craft that can dive underwater and underground. In the game it can carry up to two units besides Inazuman.
Joji Yuki transforms by donning a reinforced suit. His right arm is mechanized and fits various attachments such as the Power Arm and Rope Arm. His machine is the Riderman Machine.
Riderman's dedicated machine, converted from an ordinary motorcycle. The mask, reinforced suit and attachments are stored under the seat. Nuclear-powered, it can reach a top speed of 250 km/h.
Akira's caretaker, a woman who shakes off Shadow's pursuers with him and continues life on the run. She was actually an android built by Gill.
and has a specification that pushes its solo combat ability to the extreme. Its weapons include the Twin Linear Gun and Maser Bits.

A super robot that robotics engineer Kenichiro Kurenai spent four years developing. It is piloted by his younger brother Ken Kurenai. It boasts an output of 10,000 horsepower, and its special attack is the Electrigger, a 100-million-volt high-voltage current released from its head. It was later powered up with the Space Wings and the Drill Arrow.
Red Baron's flight form fitted with the Space Wings designed by Dr. Mikami. Red Baron can fly on its own, but equipping the Space Wings let it sortie into space as well.
A Brain Party invasion robot. It causes landslides with the Megaton Roller at its front and fires destruction rays from the horn on its head. It killed young Saburo's family.
The enhanced transformation of the Acrobatter that happens when RX turns into Robo Rider. Top speed 800 km/h. It can fire rockets from its rear. It has a sturdy body.
It confuses enemies by firing phantom rays from its eyes. It can also fly and swoops down to attack enemies.

Goro Watari's mother, separated from him 15 years ago and missing ever since. Goro himself confirmed it was her through a matching rose pendant and a rose-shaped birthmark. Because she had mutant potential, Banba forcibly remodeled her, and she transforms into Bara Banbara. But she had not lost her mother's heart.

A robot made by Brain as One-Seven's younger brother. Because it has a built-in Satan Circuit, it obeys only Brain's orders. But after opening its heart a little to young Yazaki, it gradually awakens to a sense of justice.
